reviews.title: Use to be awesome…
reviews.text: Ads now and I have to pay for the same information I once had access to for free? Nope uninstalled. Had it since it came out but oh well.

reviews.title: Allergies
reviews.text: I have a shellfish allergy but I don’t want to rule out all seafood, especially with fish I enjoy like salmon. But when I have only shellfish marked on avoid I still get things like shrimp popping up.

reviews.title: Not suitable for people who don’t eat meat
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app no less than one minute. I set my dietary requirements to pescatarian and I go on the homepage and immediately it’s showing me chicken options. I changed it to vegetarian. It’s still showing me chicken options. 
I’ve already deleted it. Thumbs down from me!

reviews.title: It’s changed
reviews.text: This app was so easy and great to use when it first came out, now it’s completely different and way more complicated. It’s just not the same anymore. Too much going on in the app.

reviews.title: Awful app & customer service
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for about 6 months now and one day the app wouldn’t open. I just got a blue screen and it froze. I uninstalled the app and reinstalled it but when I logged back in, I had NONE of my recipes I’d saved and cooked. Everything I’d found and cooked was now gone. I reached out to their “customer service” which was a huge joke. I got one email reply telling me to login instead of create a new account. The lady clearly didn’t read my email or she thinks I’m just an idiot. Either way, it was bad customer service and I’m still left with a waste of time and money. I’ve already cancelled this membership so it will NOT renew. 

The food is ok, I guess. I’ve tried several recipes and only a handful have been ones I would repeat. To me it’s not worth the money when I can find the same stuff on IG or TT.

reviews.title: Looking for an app that gives recipe ideas.
reviews.text: Had the app for 20 minutes to check it out given the 400k reviews. It was a pain. IMO this app needs a way to filter out drinks and desserts. I’m looking for meal ideas and if the recommendations are 99% drinks and desserts, it doesn’t help out much. Saw one good recipe that was very basic, and I could have done an easy google search for it. Improve the filter ability and it might be a good enough app to download again.

reviews.title: app so broken
reviews.text: App is so broken I can’t even log in anymore. Uninstalled and reinstalled and nothing still. Super frustrating and disappointing.

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: The videos don’t work and say their unavailable very unfortunate.

reviews.title: Not for kids!! - inappropriate ads!
reviews.text:
The app description says that it is for ages 4+ but it’s letting ads inappropriate for young kids. My son has been cooking and was excited about having this app on his Android phone, which has A LOT of parental restrictions. However, through this app inappropriate ads (sexualized Temu ads if you must know) appeared. I tried to report it directly from the ad, which made it disappear only to reappear a few seconds later. 
He’s uninstalled it. I only installed it to write this review.
I also see that people can post pictures of what they made. Are those pictures being regulated or like the ads in this app, anything can show up there?

reviews.title: Dietary preferences
reviews.text: I’m gf and it’s literally only suggesting recipes with gluten

reviews.title: Logged off my tasty app, now I have to pay monthly?!
reviews.text: What kind of BS is happening here? I’ve used tasty for many years, and now I have to sign up? I lost all my saved meals and whatever I have contributed to this app. So disappointed!

reviews.title: Don’t use
reviews.text: How do you find your saved recipes on this stupid app

reviews.title: Waste
reviews.text: The app is bloated with ads, the layout is so congested that you can hardly find the information you need, they force you to create an account to bookmark any recipes, and the recipes are just GARBAGE. It's a complete waste of food, time, sanity, and energy. They make enticing videos for youtube but the end result in real life is pathetic. Use a legit cookbook instead.

reviews.title: Terrible recipes are taking up my phones storage
reviews.text: I added this app because they had a couple recipes I liked. Now, they send me recipes that are all either disgusting or are just something that it seems are thrown together by someone who doesn’t care and just trying to rush out content. I’m deleting this app today after having not been attracted to any one recipe in over a year. Why take up space on my phone when I can just google recipes that are actually good and usable?

reviews.title: Only Filters Some Allergies
reviews.text: It doesn't have many options for foods to avoid. I’m allergic to all kinds of peppers, and very much hate most beans. There was no option to filter out those recipes. I would have liked to see that.

reviews.title: Ratings???
reviews.text: Don't know why people rate this app so high.  I wanted to find peanut butter frosting (icing) recipe.  Did not exist or even get close. App will be deleted.
